remarks: Experience the excitement of South Norwalk, within just minutes to the waterfront, train station and the areas best restaurants and shops! This spacious, sun filled one bedroom end unit has a beautiful open floor plan, breakfast bar, 10 ft ceilings, living room/dining combo and large south facing windows. This is one of the only units in the complex with a private deck, which is accessible from both the living room and the bedroom. There is a walk in closet in the bedroom and hardwood floors throughout. Secured lobby and quiet community with off street parking. Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity to live in the heart of it all!
